findings.summary: The app announcement region is removed when empty, so updates may insert the live region and its message simultaneously and go unannounced.
findings.fix: Render the role=status element continuously, even when empty, and update only its text; keep the dismiss control available only when a message exists.

findings.summary: A successful cart save clears a preceding product-save error, so checkout or product editing can hide a persistence failure and announce success despite unsaved changes.
findings.fix: Track the outcome of each write in a multi-write operation; retain and announce any failure, and announce completion only when every required write succeeds.
findings.evidence: Both persistProducts and persistCart clear storageNotice after their own successful write.

findings.summary: Product-management search and category filtering replace the table or empty state without announcing how many results remain.
findings.fix: Add an always-present polite status region that updates with the shown product count, including zero results, when search or category changes.

findings.summary: The cart count changes after cart actions, but the count is not announced unless a user happens to revisit or focus the cart link.
findings.fix: Update a persistent polite status message with the new cart total whenever the count changes.
findings.evidence: const cartCount = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0)

findings.summary: The image-preview success status is conditionally mounted with its message, so assistive technology may not announce that URL validation succeeded.
findings.fix: Keep an empty role=status region mounted and update its text when preview validation succeeds; clear it when the input changes.

findings.summary: Recoverable image validation errors use role=alert, which can interrupt users assertively for routine input feedback.
findings.fix: Use a polite, persistent status region for these recoverable messages and associate the error with the relevant input.
